Atlantic Tropical Outlook

NHC issued: 800 PM EDT Mon Oct 19 2026
Regardless of the status of the system, high winds, coastal
flooding, and dangerous surf are expected along portions of the U.S. East Coast during the next few days. For more information, please consult statements and warnings from local National Weather Service offices and the Weather Prediction Center, along with High Seas Forecasts and Storm Warnings issued by the National Weather Service.

E. Pacific Tropical Outlook

NHC issued: 500 PM PDT Mon Oct 19 2026
South of Southern Mexico (EP94):
Showers and thunderstorms are beginning to show signs of organization in association with a trough of low pressure located several hundred miles south-southwest of the coasts of Guatemala and El Salvador. Environmental conditions appear conducive for development, and a tropical depression is expected to form in the next day or so as the system moves westward to west-northwestward at around 10 mph, remaining well offshore of Central America and southern Mexico.
